comment: do_name.c Monnam() is upstart(), whose highc() changes only 'a'-'z'. The Samurai names his dog "ßob" (keys 0xC3 0x9F, the UTF-8 bytes of 'ß') and chats to it: sounds.c domonnoise() prints "%s barks." with Monnam(), so the name keeps its first byte, where an upper-casing that knows 'ß' would write "SS".
